resources.string: Tilt a wooden board and send the balls rolling

PhysicsBody.step supplies gravity and the floor bounce; this sample adds mass-weighted sphere impulses at a fixed 120 Hz step. Balls roll as solid spheres do: 5/7 of the slope\'s pull, minus a little rolling resistance. Rubber bounces, steel is heavy and barely bounces, glass sits in between. Tap the board to drop a ball there; drag a ball to carry it, let go mid-swipe to throw it — the held ball shoves the others aside. Reset replays the same opening shot.
Drag the board to tip it · tap to drop a ball
Drag to turn around the board · tap to drop a ball

The board hangs off one pivot node, up to 35° either way. Each frame it eases towards the drag and the gravity vector is rotated into the tilt that frame shows, so the floor plane and rails stay flat in the simulation while the balls roll down the slope on screen.
